# Michigan Lawyers Weekly

> Michigan Lawyers Weekly is a comprehensive legal news and professional development platform serving Michigan's legal community with daily alerts, events, awards programs, and networking opportunities.

Michigan Lawyers Weekly provides Michigan attorneys and legal professionals with timely legal news, court opinions, verdicts, and continuing legal education through webinars and events. The platform also features recognition programs, a lawyer directory, job classifieds, and advertising solutions for the legal industry.

## Key Topics

- Michigan legal news
- court opinions
- verdicts and settlements
- legal jobs
- continuing legal education
- Michigan lawyers directory
- professional development
- legal events and webinars
- lawyer recognition awards
- Michigan law
- legal community
- Michigan Supreme Court
- Michigan Circuit Courts
- legal industry
- legal professionals

## News & Alerts

- [Michigan Lawyers Weekly](https://milawyersweekly.com): Homepage for Michigan Lawyers Weekly legal news publication
- [The MiLW Daily Alert](https://milawyersweekly.com/daily-alert): Daily legal news alert service with court opinions and verdicts

## Awards & Recognition Programs

- [Hall of Fame/Up & Coming Lawyers](https://milawyersweekly.com/event/hall-of-fame-up-coming-lawyers): Hall of Fame awards recognizing Michigan legal leaders and contributions
- [Empowering Women 2025](https://milawyersweekly.com/empowering-women-2025): Awards program recognizing women attorneys and law firms
- [In The Lead](https://milawyersweekly.com/in-the-lead): Recognition program highlighting top businesses and family-led law firms
- [Michigan's 'Go To' Lawyers](https://milawyersweekly.com/michigans-go-to-lawyers-2): Recognition program honoring top lawyers by practice area in Michigan

## Events & Professional Development

- [Events Calendar](https://milawyersweekly.com/events): Events calendar for legal conferences, webinars, and professional development
- [Michigan Lawyers Weekly Webinars](https://milawyersweekly.com/events/michigan-lawyers-weekly-webinars): Continuing legal education webinars for Michigan legal professionals
- [Diversity & Inclusion in the Legal and Business Environment](https://milawyersweekly.com/diversity-inclusion-event): Event focused on diversity and inclusion in Michigan legal community

## Lawyer Directory & Employment

- [Lawyer Directory](https://milawyersweekly.com/lawyer-directory): Directory of Michigan lawyers and law firm rankings
- [Classifieds](https://milawyersweekly.com/classifieds): Legal job classifieds and employment opportunities in Michigan
- [Submit Your Legal Job Posting](https://milawyersweekly.com/submit-your-legal-job-posting-here): Job posting submission form for legal employment opportunities

## Subscriptions & Account Management

- [Subscribe](https://milawyersweekly.com/subscribe): Subscription page for Michigan Lawyers Weekly legal publication
- [User Login](https://milawyersweekly.com/user-login): User login and authentication portal for Michigan Lawyers Weekly
- [Manage Your Email Subscriptions](https://milawyersweekly.com/manage-account-em): Email subscription management for Michigan Lawyers Weekly subscribers

## Business & Resources

- [Advertising](https://milawyersweekly.com/advertising): Advertising and marketing solutions for legal industry
- [Resources](https://milawyersweekly.com/resources): Legal resources including statutes, court opinions, and bar associations

## Optional

- [Submit Verdicts or Settlements](https://milawyersweekly.com/submit-verdicts): Submission form for verdicts and settlements to Michigan Lawyers Weekly
- [Behind the Deal Submissions](https://milawyersweekly.com/behind-the-deal-submissions): Submission form for mergers, acquisitions, and deal announcements
- [Submit a Letter to the Editor](https://milawyersweekly.com/submit-letters): Letter to the editor submission form for Michigan legal community
